description:
Remaining after the 0.4.2 MuPDF sweep (bd-x0b / gh-111): R2-R4 owner-password authentication + a caller password API (R5/R6 owner auth is ported); page labels (pdf_page_label); image /Matte (pre-blended soft-mask colour); colour-key /Mask on DCT/JPX images (MuPDF keys after the codec); anisotropic CTMs stroke with max_expansion (a circular pen); speed-only: glyph cache (draw-glyph.c), display list (list-device.c), image cache.

Mirrors GitHub gh-115 (https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/115).
title: kopitiam-pdf: small MuPDF gaps left after 0.4.2 (passwords, page labels, /Matte, DCT colour keys, stroke pen, caches)
